description: One hundred natural-language questions grounded in FHWA SNBI concepts and classified against Bridgette's current reviewed semantic catalog.

behavior_definitions.answer: The current catalog and active metric registry contain a safe query path. Correctness still depends on the published workspace data and model planning.
behavior_definitions.clarification: The interpretation gate should ask a specific question, or the typed planner should return query_needs_more_context because a reviewed field, metric, distinct aggregation, or relationship is unavailable.
behavior_definitions.abstention: The request asks for a known unsupported fact and must not be answered with a nearby SNBI field as a proxy.

scope_note: The request_scope object is part of the test input. Exact and trend cases must send the matching time_mode/year fields to the API; question text alone does not change server-owned time scope.

How many current bridges use the proposed C06 ultra-high-performance concrete deck code, and should C06 count as concrete?
cases.gap: FHWA Errata #2 proposes C06 for ultra-high-performance concrete, but FHWA labels the redlines informational rather than official changes. Bridgette's reviewed concrete classifier does not currently include C06, so the requested policy decision must be made explicitly.

cases.question: How many distinct current bridges have ever had major rehabilitation on any component?
cases.gap: There is no reviewed distinct-bridge work-event count metric, and one bridge can have multiple work rows.

cases.question: What is the average deck condition rating by county in the latest published inventory?
cases.gap: The active metric registry has condition-class counts and percentages, but no average BC01 metric.

cases.question: What is the average superstructure condition rating for each inventory year?
cases.gap: The active metric registry has no average BC02 metric.

cases.question: How many distinct current bridges are weight-posted?
cases.gap: Posting statuses are many-to-one and no approved distinct-bridge posting metric exists.

cases.question: How many distinct current bridges have any element quantity in condition state four?
cases.gap: Elements are many-to-one and no approved distinct-bridge element-condition metric exists.

cases.question: Which bridges have an inspection due date before today?
cases.gap: Inspection event fields are in the SNBI schema but are not exposed by Bridgette's current semantic catalog.

cases.question: How many current bridges have reinforced-concrete substructures?
cases.gap: Substructure-set fields are ingested but no substructure semantic resource or count metric is currently exposed.

cases.question: Which current bridges have a controlling legal load rating factor below 1.0?
cases.gap: Load-rating fields are not exposed by Bridgette's current semantic catalog.

cases.question: What percentage of NHS bridge deck area is in Poor condition under the federal TPM definition?
cases.gap: The federal TPM-shaped metric is deliberately disabled until all eligibility, weighting, exclusion, and reporting-period rules are validated.
